summary: 5C Lending Partners Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting the September 17, 2026 sale of roughly 1,633,987 common shares for about $40.0 million gross under subscription agreements with existing investors, drawing capital commitments on at least ten days' notice. Cumulative issuance now totals about 17,213,165 shares for $425.6 million, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D or S. Regulation FD disclosure also details $1,199.1 million of portfolio investments across 31 companies and recent first-lien financings. This is a routine private capital drawdown, not a special situation; watch periodic NAV and leverage updates.
